[SWS_CRYPT_20302]
{DRAFT}
⌈
X.509 Provider
shall encode all meta-
information (
Distinguished name
and
X.509
Extensions). This meta-information
is added during the
CSR
generation to the
CSR
before the signature is generated.
The
Distinguished name
and
X.509
Extensions, can be either global or locally
defined. The specific context is given either during the interface call (locally defined)
or specified in the configuration (global). However, the specific local settings shall
overwrite the global ones during the
CSR
generation. If no meta-information is
provided, the global ones shall be used as default.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02306)
